Name ITF-2 (Imagine The Future 2, Yui 2, TO 89, Tsukuba-OSCAR 89)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2019-01-03. Was semi-operational. Was operational until 2018-09-22, one communication system stopped working, but sent CW beacon until decay. (Website)
Launched 2016-12-09
NORAD ID 41932
Deployer J-SSOD (JEM Small Satellite Orbital Deployer)
Launcher H-IIB (H2B)
Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2017-01-16
Organisation University of Tsukuba
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation Japan
Launch brokerer JAXA
Oneliner

Amateur radio communications and small antenna.
Description

Establish human network by amateur satellite. Prove the ability of the micro engineered 1/20 wavelength small antenna.
